environment: Actual Cloud Run Firebase-authenticated API + dedicated Cloud SQL PostgreSQL16, HTTPS from operator workstation
assumptions: Four synchronized131-client bursts, not a soak test or physical mobile-radio test
One accepted synthetic trip per driver; direct fixture seeding, reservation invariants tested separately
Includes TLS/WAN and Firebase revocation checks cached for at most10seconds; server membership checked every request
At most2 Cloud Run API instances; 20 PostgreSQL connections per instance
Later run reuses synthetic trips with open visits and sends strictly later timestamps; first-run cold costs are not identical
Synchronization latency measured from each own successful telemetry response to its next scoped snapshot; acknowledged commit precedes this timer
